sentences.en: It is necessary to secure financing for local road maintenance.
sentences.zh: 必须为当地的道路保养筹集资金。

sentences.en: He was in charge of maintenance at the chocolate factory.
sentences.zh: 他负责巧克力工厂的维护工作。

sentences.en: We're having a short maintenance break, we'll be back shortly!
sentences.zh: 我们稍作维护停顿，很快就回来！

senses.zh: 维护，保养；维持；（依法应负担的）生活费，抚养费
